folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B381: full census, grouped counts and actual consumers
folds.body:
All853 original lines were read, including every cell in the seven shard tables, top12 ranking, fifteen UI forms and near-miss/additional/already-built lists. [Text-only row arithmetic](../reconciliation-2026-11-04/map-counts-b381.json) reproduces31 BUILT,280 PARTIAL,20 DESIGNED-ELSEWHERE and115 UNBUILT rows, plus one n/a row. These446 status-bearing rows include grouped IDs and notes; they are not446 individually reviewed original packets. The displayed80 source sections do not by themselves explain the header's94 input files. That source-roster gap stays explicit rather than inventing omitted files. No linked packet, source game, current code or test was newly read by reading this census.

The audit itself defines its statuses as keyword/file discovery, often inferred. Preserve useful packet ideas, not global completion/absence claims. A known recipe is not current tool/body/station access; a qualification, membership or landing permission is not physical faculty; standing buys access while currency pays its price; ownership/custody is not possession or permission; charge/capacity/quality/purity/workmanship are different axes. A named source with silence support is not ambient-speech arbitration. Rival/companion policy and paid wage cannot be assumed present or absent in an entire novel from a fit note. Actual source actor, law and mechanism decide. The original game-local one-use/one-per-life/cap examples are palette numbers, not universal limits under AD22/AD38.

Retain specific consequential joins: an inconclusive paid test changes a later decision; a working sample teaches an executable method through an actual recipient; a loan/tool/source changes a downstream action; a completed funded job and collectible payment have different lifetimes; an incurred obligation survives a fading memory recap; copied records, interpreted claims and observed confirmation have distinct provenance. Stale reports name observation time rather than inventing truth. A visible absence of stock requires known scope; an unsupported port is not zero or proof that a hidden route does not exist. A return summary grants no second work/reward/allowance, and a replayed cue does not rerun settlement.

Finite routines, studies, travel, appointments and catch-up use their actual clocks, supports, resource commitments and meaningful stops. World schedules, paused lives, inherited state, banked time and succession reset different scopes. Neither “no loop code” nor “LOTM is not a loop world” is a universal mechanism conclusion. Current AD44 keeps the protagonist development route and separate ordinary seats; AD51 selects useful shared seams without a universal framework prerequisite; AD52 compresses activity while preserving decisions and long play. Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md) governs build order, not these ranked “fit now” guesses.

Keep UI suggestions as forms serving a real question: truthful departure/return/carry rows, supplied-check attribution, known uncertainty, named blockers, actual producer rates/limits, settlement receipts, appointment history and a dated source ledger. Four chips beside every ability, a theater board, an inner voice, exact safe-time gauge, mandatory day bar or new clue graph is not required merely because the audit calls it absent. Prose-first/current shell, player overrides and observer knowledge govern; “true versus gossiped” cannot publish private truth. Later complete [palette coverage](../../gm/dispatch/palette-completion-2026-10-20/COVERAGE.md), [interaction receipt](../../gm/dispatch/upstream-interaction-system-2026-10-20/CHECKPOINT.md) and the [similar-games plan](../../research/ABSORPTION_PLAN_SIMILAR_GAMES_2026-10-30.md) qualify specific finite receipts without certifying every family or source fact. No runtime, acquisition, external source refresh or new dispatch follows.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B381: useful seams and local condition differences
folds.body:
This full29-row plan, five recommendations, second overlap check and owner routes were read. Preserve the actual differences: ingredient quality may affect a known hazard without another stat; a study queue's elapsed work, wasted unused slot and an absorption/rest band are different mechanisms; a standing arrangement needs its actual rent/wage/dues payer, recipient, clock and settlement before a return line. Actor/target permission tests need not hide a known blocked action. Familiarity fading is not trust decay, and a named follower's refusal/availability cannot be replaced by a bounty weight. World persistence, personal reset and heirloom custody avoid duplication without imposing one universal carry policy.

The row5/recommended shared-condition second-consumer requirement reflects an earlier FND5 premise. Current AD51 permits the first useful shared seam; another different world validates or revises it rather than granting permission to start. Shared condition identity/projection does not force strain, contamination, physical damage, exposure and recovery to fade identically. Select each actual consumer and preserve its local producers, causal effects, duration/clock and remedy. A one-bag fact map would weaken existing typed ownership; choosing a new respec/hash policy requires an explicit compatibility decision, not a forced migration or private-save reset.

The recommended creation dials, study queue, weekly line and shared condition remain proposals, not approved gameplay or the current build sequence. Current [PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md), AD44/51/52 and the selected owner govern. Old source-header checks, lane/writer claims, estimated effort and no-go language are historical; they do not renew dispatch or require asking again for already authorized documentation. Source-reported closed-game shapes, external numbers/licences and source-game reliability were not refreshed. Runtime generated dialogue is separate from later authorized prose editing and the still-deferred local-AI bulk drafting pass; AD38 does not turn a prose tool choice into a new world mechanic. No code, source collection, app adoption or publication was performed.
